_why: PROVENANCE_ID as a PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTED VALUE, sourced outside the design under test.
_defect_this_replaces: run 004's bar 2 failed because the test read PROVENANCE_ID off the DUT. That is unreadable at gate level (parameters bake at synthesis) AND circular: a die carrying the wrong ID would have been graded against its own wrong ID and passed.
derivation: first 32 bits of the monogate-research commit the evidence tag points at
note: Kept SEPARATE from bist_expected.json so that file stays byte-identical between arming and the repair amendment -- the check that distinguishes fixing the thermometer from moving the target.

_supersedes.why_stale: v1 was cut before runs 005 and 006, so its frozen RTL lacks the x_in / in_valid / kernel_rst registers the passing design carries. A die pinned to v1 would point its interrogator at RTL that is not in the silicon.
